title: Thuruppugulan
desc: Menon buys land for his five-star hotel and asks his trusted employee, Sreedharan Unnithan, to take its charge. Years later, Unnithan gets Menon imprisoned in a fake case and Kunjumon helps him.

title: Comali
desc: A long coma leaves Ravi disorientated in an unrecognisable world. However, he sets out on a journey to reclaim his past and adapt to a new reality.

title: Radhakrishna
desc: When the forest department takes away the elephant, the child is left without his dearest friend. The young boy undertakes a journey to find the lost animal.

title: Nanban
desc: Two friends set out to find their friend from college, who taught them how to be more than just victims of circumstance. Along the way, they discover previously unknown truths.

title: Chakra
desc: A carefully planned mass robbery causes a police officer and a soldier to team up with each other and carry out an investigation, which reveals a vast syndicate of cybercriminals.

title: Masss
desc: After a life-threatening accident, a man finds that he can communicate with the dead, and must decide whether to act on their advice.
